text:
Estimated from the photo: about 8 strips of cooked bacon and about 12 sausage pieces, roughly 2–3 sausage links cut up.

Bacon: cooked strips weigh about 8 g each, so about 8 × 8 = 64 g. At roughly 4.5 kcal/g that is about 290 kcal for 8 strips. The strips look thin and partly broken, so I'll use about 7 strips equivalent, around 55 g and 250 kcal.

Sausage: about 12 pieces at about 8 g each is about 95 g. Breakfast sausage is about 2.7 kcal/g, which gives about 255 kcal.

Total: about 150 g of food and about 500 kcal.
